subject: Quick demo request: GitHub app + OSS workflow questions
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@openforge.dev>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in a quick demo — GitHub App + OSS workflow

Hey Connor,

I signed up on your self-serve flow this morning and poked around the GitHub connector. OpenForge is looking at automating a couple of things for our maintainers: auto-labeling on CI results, and a lightweight bot that posts triage suggestions. Before we commit to a pilot we have a couple of questions:

- What webhook scopes does your app require? Will we need admin-level repo permissions?
- Any guidance on rate limits for event-heavy orgs (we run ~200 repos, lots of CI activity)?
- Do you support partial installs (only for a subset of org repos) and how does that affect billing?

If possible wed like a quick 20-30 minute walkthrough of the connector and the integration surface this week. Availability: Monday/Tuesday afternoons PT.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Gupta
Platform Engineer | OpenForge
samir@openforge.dev

(attachment: repo-sample-list.csv)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@openforge.dev>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in a quick demo — GitHub App + OSS workflow

Hi Samir — thanks for the note and for signing up. Really glad youre trying the connector. Quick answers up front:

- Webhook scopes: we only require repository-level webhooks and the Apps/Installations scope; admin rights are only needed if you want the app to auto-install across an org. You can do a subset install for specific repos.
- Rate limits: we have per-customer throttling and suggest configuring event filtering on the webhook to reduce noisy CI events; well share recommended filtering rules in the call.
- Billing: partial installs are supported; billing is based on tokens/requests for the protected routes, not on total org size.

Ive looped in Marissa from Solutions (cc) to help with the tech checklist. Would you be available for a 25-min slot? Proposed times:
- Mon Jun 22, 2:00–2:30 PM PT
- Tue Jun 23, 3:00–3:30 PM PT
- Tue Jun 23, 4:30–4:55 PM PT

Please pick a slot (or send a calendar invite) — I can also send over a short agenda and a quick pre-call checklist.

Cheers,
Connor OBrien
SDR, Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.ai
Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min

- Decide whether you want webhook event filtering for CI run events (we usually filter by workflow_run and pull_request).
- Do you have a preferred GitHub org role to install the app, or do you want us to demo the subset-install flow?

Ill join Monday afternoon — Im available Jun 22 2:00–3:00 PM PT. Connor, if Samir picks that slot, Ill post a calendar invite and include a Google Drive link with the agenda + sample webhook filters.
